reviewSamples.author: Michael Morakis
reviewSamples.text: Today was the first time I have used Marwan’s services (Best for Less Home Solutions). I certainly do not regret it. He was on time like he said he would be. He diagnosed the problem with my toilet immediately and he did an excellent job …

reviewSamples.author: Taylor Canerday
reviewSamples.text: Marwan was super helpful! He stopped by the same day I called, and quickly reviewed the leak. I would definitely call him again for future projects.

reviewSamples.author: Puneet Gupta
reviewSamples.text: Very responsive and timely communication. The problem was very small and he did not charge anything for driving over to my house. Highly recommend!

reviewSamples.author: Kindy Kulosa
reviewSamples.text: Harwam was here two different days! He gave a fair price for his work and materials. A very nice guy who did a great job on the two sinks installing them and replacing a faucet and parts to my shower. He also replaced some broken parts on …

reviewSamples.author: James
reviewSamples.text: I can’t say how professional and knowledgeable Marwan was at installing all toilets at my home. He was very prompt, got there 30 minutes prior to our scheduled. His pricing was great, he kept his work grind being to the end, (no hidden fees). I strongly recommend him if you want. Good service.
